# UrbanBreathe
> Air-quality estimates for ten Indian cities. It applies the CPCB National AQI method to modelled CAMS data (via Open-Meteo) and labels every value with its source, time and data basis. Not an official CPCB station AQI.

## Views (single-page app; routes are #<view>/<city>)
- [Current Conditions](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/#dashboard/delhi): NAQI-method estimate with per-pollutant means, valid hours and CPCB sub-indices; hourly PM2.5, PM10, NO₂, O₃, SO₂, CO (µg/m³); modelled weather
- [Model Forecast](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/#forecast/delhi): past 24 h and next 72 h of the CAMS model; not evaluated against observations
- [Source Context](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/#sources/delhi): descriptive indicators only — no source apportionment
- [Scenario Explorer](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/#simulator/delhi): illustrative arithmetic with editable, labelled assumptions; no health or cost estimates
- [City Comparison](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/#comparative/delhi): ranked estimates with timestamps; a screening view, not an enforcement priority
- [Situation Brief](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/#brief/delhi): printable summary with data basis and limitations
- [Citizen Advisory](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/#advisory/delhi): quoted CPCB health statement and general precautions (English, Hindi, Bengali, Telugu)
- [Data & Method](https://urban-breathe-nine.vercel.app/#method/delhi): sources, calculation, breakpoints and limitations

## API Reference
- GET /api/cities — supported cities
- GET /api/air-quality/:cityId — current NAQI-method estimate, sub-indices, hourly values, provenance
- GET /api/forecast/:cityId — recent 24 h and 72 h model forecast
- GET /api/sources/:cityId — source context indicators (no apportionment)
- GET /api/simulation/interventions — intervention catalogue with placeholder assumptions
- POST /api/simulation/run — illustrative scenario; optional user-edited assumptions
- POST /api/brief/generate — situation brief
- GET /api/advisory/:cityId?lang=en|hi|bn|te — citizen advisory
- GET /api/health — server health check

## Data
- [Open-Meteo Air Quality API](https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/air-quality-api): CAMS global model output (CC BY 4.0, free for non-commercial use)
- Demo fixtures: used only when the server runs with DATA_MODE=demo, always labelled DEMO
- Method: CPCB National Air Quality Index (CUPS/82/2014-15); see docs/methodology/naqi.md in the repository
